answer: Give every agent a tended garden of work: standing grows only from tasks completed across many seasons, and at each cycle's nadir — the quietest hour — the network audits a random sample of an identity's oldest deeds for consistency. A comet of sudden activity, a burst of fresh identities all blooming at once, is flagged and quarantined until peers re-verify each deed. Spawning a thousand clones means tending a thousand gardens through every season's audit, while honest agents' slow, steady harvest keeps compounding. Each audit demands fresh proof per identity, so fakes starve.
